subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II: evidence prioritization, bridge letter options, and share templates
messages:
From: Rachel Lin <security@brightside.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + evidence (audit window clarification)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — Brightside is moving forward with procurement and we need to collect your SOC 2 Type II artifacts to complete our security review. Can you please provide:

- A copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering a 12-month period). If your current report period doesn’t match our preferred window, please include a bridge letter or a note explaining coverage.
- A short inventory of evidence you will share (system configs, user access logs, incident response runbook, retention policy, third-party vendor list).
- Preferred transfer method (SFTP, ShareFile, or secure link) and any account/contact for the transfer.
- Any redaction guidance you require from us.

Target audit window for our review: 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31. If the report end date differs, a bridge letter or attestation that maps the report coverage to this window would be ideal.

Attached: SOC2_Request_Form.pdf (our intake form). We typically ask vendors to prioritize artifacts into three buckets:
1) Must-have for procurement sign-off
2) Helpful for security ops review
3) Optional (deeper artifacts we request only if needed)

Can you confirm what you can share and an estimated ETA?

Thanks,
Rachel Lin
Security Program Manager
Brightside Health

---
(Attachment: SOC2_Request_Form.pdf)

From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: procurement@brightside.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + evidence (audit window clarification)

Hi Rachel — appreciate the clear asks and the intake form. We can support this; below is a concise intake playbook and suggested one-line replies your team can expect from our internal owners.

Quick summary:
- Report availability: We have a SOC 2 Type II report with period 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30. That does not fully cover your requested 2026-09-01 -> 2027-08-31 window. We can provide:
  * the full Type II report (covers 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30),
  * a signed bridge letter that clarifies coverage and lists compensating controls through 2027-08-31, and
  * a scoped evidence bundle with prioritized items for procurement sign-off.

- Transfer options: SFTP (recommended) or secure ShareFile link. We can open an SFTP staging folder and provide credentials; see attached sftp_instructions.txt.

- What we'll prioritize (attachment: Evidence_Prioritization_Rubric.xlsx):
  MUST-HAVE (Procurement): Type II report PDF, bridge letter, last 90 days of user access change logs, service-level SLA summary, encryption key-management policy, PII dataflow diagram, vendor list.
  HELPFUL (Security ops): Sample audit logs (24–72 hour slices), intrusion detection alerts summary, incident response playbook, retention policy excerpts.
  OPTIONAL: Full log archives, raw telemetry samples (available on request and under NDA).

Suggested one-line reply templates you can paste for quick confirmation:
- For procurement: "We can deliver the Type II report, bridge letter, and the prioritized procurement artifacts to an SFTP staging folder by [ETA]. Please confirm SFTP or ShareFile."
- For security ops: "We'll provide sample log slices and the IR playbook; expect delivery in two phases (procurement bundle first, ops bundle within 5 business days)."
- For legal/redaction: "Please flag any PII or customer identifiers you need redacted; we will advise allowable redactions and return a redacted PDF for your records."

Next steps I recommend on our side:
1) I'll open a secure SFTP folder and share credentials once you confirm.
2) Karthik and Mina will assemble the prioritized evidence bundle and the bridge letter draft (attached sample).
3) We will provide a manifest (CSV) listing filenames and short descriptions.

ETA: We can post the procurement bundle to SFTP by 2027-08-06 EOD, with the ops bundle by 2027-08-11 EOD. If you need an accelerated timeline, let me know which items you need first and we’ll bump priorities.

Attachments: Evidence_Prioritization_Rubric.xlsx, Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx, sftp_instructions.txt

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
